topic: 限时听力：学术独白与阶段测评
grammarFocus: 学术句子的主干、修饰关系与名词短语；被动表达。
title: Timed Listening and Staged Assessment in University Study
prompt: Some universities now require students to complete timed listening tests in which they follow extended academic monologues, and to sit short staged assessments at fixed points during a course rather than relying only on a final examination. Some educators argue that this combination builds the listening and sustained-attention skills students need for real academic work, while others believe it mainly rewards test technique and adds unnecessary pressure. To what extent do you agree or disagree that timed listening tasks combined with staged assessments are a fair and effective way to measure and develop students' academic listening ability? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先明确你对“限时学术独白听力＋阶段性测评”这一组合的态度：完全同意、部分同意还是不同意，并在开头段直接表明立场。主体段需围绕你的立场展开论证，可从公平性、能力培养、考试压力、测试技巧与真实学术能力的区别等角度选择两到三个重点，每段给出理由并配以具体例子。注意回应题目中的两个关键词：fair（公平）与effective（有效），不要只讨论其中一个。结尾段重申立场并简要总结理由。全文不少于250词，建议用时40分钟，写完后检查是否始终围绕同一立场、例子是否具体、段落之间是否有清晰逻辑连接。
